title: Development works for promotion of tourism at Krishnapatnam Lighthouse Station.
summary: Percentage-rate e-tender for tourism development works at Krishnapatnam Lighthouse, Muthukuru, Nellore district, Andhra Pradesh.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, Port Residential Area, Saligramapuram, Visakhapatnam

sites.name: Krishnapatnam Lighthouse, Muthukuru, Gopalapuram Post, Nellore Dist., Andhra Pradesh 524344
sites.work: Development works for promotion of tourism

scope.item: Development works for promotion of tourism (no BOQ in these pages)

money.notes: Estimated cost including GST and all other taxes. EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Visakhapatnam; validity four months (table) or three months (clause 1.2). Clause 1.2 Hindi says no bidder exempted from EMD, but English note exempts MSEs registered in MSME on submission of a bid-securing declaration.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from the date of opening of tender

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category & class with Central Government/CPWD/State Government/Railways/MES/BSNL/PSU, and valid electrical licence

Similar works completed in last seven years: three works each >= 40% of estimated cost, or two each >= 50%, or one >= 80%; similar works = construction/maintenance of buildings and other civil structures; values updated at 7% per annum
PAN and GST registration; key technical personnel; unconditional tender undertaking (Annexure V); tender acceptance letter (Annexure IV)
Non-blacklisting affidavit; income tax returns FY 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25
List of relatives serving in MoPSW or DGLL
Average annual turnover of last three financial years at least 30% of estimated cost
Activity chart/plan; self-assessing technical evaluation sheet; valid labour licence or self-declaration; bank mandate form with cancelled cheque
notes: Extract of pages 3-7 of a 102-page tender document (Section I NIT only); no BOQ. Bid download/submission 01/12/2025 18:00 to 11/12/2025 15:00. Heavy vehicles permitted to site. Director's signature dated 1/12/25.
